title: Fin Planning Pod Ep 2 — The 41.6 Lakh Bangalore Plan
description: Pavit, a data and AI specialist in Bangalore, earns 41.6 lakh rupees, invests 92,000 rupees every month, and stepped his SIP up from 3,000 rupees in 2018 to 75,000 rupees while building an 80.75 lakh portfolio.

title: Fin Planning Pod Ep 1 — The 82 Lakh Warangal Plan
description: Jitender from Warangal earns 82.8 lakh rupees from salary, freelancing, and rent, invests 1.88 lakh every month, and built a 2.05 crore portfolio from a 6,000 rupee first salary.
